reviews.title: Excellence as always!
reviews.comment:
Using this for an exhaust fan for my heated 3d printer enclosure.  I wanted fans which ran at the printers 'native' 24v.  It's pushing air outside through a ac infinity 4" duct to a dryer vent.  At full speed the air coming out the vent outside feels like a leaf blower as far as force and amount of air being moved.  Can't go wrong with noctua as always!
3d printers put out tons of VOCs and none of the filaments are technically safe in any way.  Protect yourself and your family with a proper enclosure and venting to the outside.  For critical tasks like this noctua iPPC is a clear choice for reliability and dependability.
I've been using their iPPC fans in servers for nearly ten years and they are always amazing in their performance.
reviews.author: Zara

reviews.title: When you gotta blow on that thing...  NOCTUA!!
reviews.comment: I put two of these fans in the front of my shop PC as intakes.  In the shop, I am not concerned with noise and the processor I used has a reputation for being warm.  These fans move a LOT of air.  The build quality of these is excellent and the performance is top notch tho again at the cost of noise.  I'm very happy with my purchase and recommend anyone looking for good strong fans to get one or two of these.  You will be blown away.  =)
reviews.author: S. H. Mellish
